An '''individual''' and their friend tried to apprehend young [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] at the [[Daiyu marketplace]], in an attempt to get her to reveal the location of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and claim the [[bounty]] on him. However, their friend was shot down and the blue one was hit unconscious by Kenobi, who was trying to protect the girl.<ref name="P2" />
